title: Inception
events_chronological: Cobb and his wife Mal spend fifty subjective years together in Limbo, building a world out of memory.
To get Mal to wake up, Cobb plants in her mind the idea that her world is not real.
The idea keeps growing after they wake; Mal throws herself from a hotel window and frames Cobb for her murder.
Cobb flees the United States and works as an extractor for hire, unable to go home to his children.
Cobb and Arthur run an extraction on the energy magnate Saito that collapses when Mal's projection intervenes.
Saito, impressed rather than angry, hires Cobb to plant an idea in his rival's heir Robert Fischer in exchange for having his record cleared.
Cobb assembles the chemist Yusuf, the forger Eames and the student architect Ariadne, whom his father-in-law Miles points him to in Paris.
Ariadne learns to build dream architecture and finds the memory prison in Cobb's mind where the Mal projection lives.
Fischer's father dies and the team boards the dead man's son onto a ten-hour flight to Los Angeles.
On the first level Yusuf drives the van through rain-soaked streets while Fischer's militarised subconscious attacks and Saito is shot.
On the second level Eames impersonates Fischer's godfather Browning in a hotel to turn Fischer against him.
On the third level the team assault a snow fortress where Eames sets charges and Fischer is meant to reach his father's safe.
Mal's projection shoots Fischer dead inside the fortress, and Cobb and Ariadne go down into Limbo to bring him back.
Cobb admits to Mal in Limbo that he was the one who planted the idea that killed her.
Cobb refuses the projection's offer to stay and lets Mal go.
Ariadne pushes Fischer off a balcony to wake him, and he opens his father's safe to find the will and the paper pinwheel.
Yusuf's van hits the water, Arthur's lift charge fires and Eames blows the fortress, and the kicks cascade back up through the levels.
Cobb stays behind in Limbo to search for the aged Saito.
Cobb washes up on a shore and is carried to a Japanese castle where Saito is an old man, and the two remind each other of their deal and shoot themselves awake.
Everyone wakes on the plane, Saito makes the phone call, Cobb is waved through immigration and comes home to his children as the top spins on the table.
syuzhet_notes: Told-order bullet 1 is a flash-forward to the film's penultimate scene, which the narrative returns to at bullet 19. Told-order bullets 7, 8 and 14 are flashbacks into Cobb's marriage, released in pieces as Ariadne pries them out of him, with the worst of it - that he planted the idea that killed Mal - withheld until the deepest level. From bullet 10 onwards the film runs four nested dream levels at once at wildly different rates.
fabula_notes: The dream levels are simultaneous rather than sequential and time dilates roughly twentyfold at each level down, so laying bullets 10-17 out as one chronological line flattens four clocks running together. Whether the closing scene is real is deliberately left open by the still-spinning top.
